messages:
maria: FYI hitting a parity issue in the onboarding flow. The hosted REST has an admin-only endpoint we use for model metadata but the Node SDK doesn't surface it.

alex: which admin endpoint?

maria: `/admin/models/list` — we call it to populate the model selector with quant profiles, cost tier, and supported hardware. curl -> 200 + full metadata. SDK call returns the shorter public model list.

sam: confirmed. SDK's listModels() points at /v1/models not /admin/models/list, so the extra admin fields are missing.

maria: another pain: the REST expects `model_version` whereas the SDK sends `modelVersion`. On the admin route the server ignores unknown keys and returns the default model set. That made the UI silently pick latest, confusing users.

diana: silent defaults are nasty for first-run UX. Do we want server-side validation or make the SDK more forgiving?

alex: both. I'll add the admin endpoint in the SDK surface and a parameter normalizer that accepts known snake_case or camelCase aliases.

sam: I'll add an e2e that asserts admin metadata fields exist (quantProfiles, billingTier). Also test both casing variants.

maria: quick hack in sampleapp: I hit the REST directly as a stopgap and it fixed the selector. We should document the temporary workaround.

devex-bot: Created issue RDW-4620: "devex: add admin models endpoint to SDK + param aliasing" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4620

diana: Alex, can you pick the SDK PR? Sam, add regression tests in sampleapp. Maria, please open the sampleapp patch with the direct REST repro.

alex: plan: (1) add client.admin.listModels(), (2) update TypeScript types, (3) add param mapper for known admin filters, (4) ship minor. Aim to open PR tomorrow morning.

maria: side note: streaming parity diff — same `stream=true` flag behaves differently. SDK buffers chunks and emits fewer, larger events, which broke our onboarding progress indicator. Not critical but worth tracking.

sam: filed RDW-4621 for streaming chunking parity so release notes can mention it.

diana: good. also let's add server-side validation to return 400 on unknown filter keys for admin endpoints; that will make SDK gaps fail loudly. Platform team, can you own that?

alex: will coordinate with platform. I'll include migration notes and a deprecation warning period for any callers relying on the old lax behavior.

maria: reopening sampleapp issue w/ screenshots and curl vs SDK snippets to make review quick.

sam: temporary workaround in the README: call the admin REST route with org API key header until SDK release.

diana: action list logged. We'll reconvene after PRs. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
